ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 60:40 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white pixel regions occupy the distal 70% of the right lobe and 50% of the left lobe. Low-intensity black pixels are concentrated around the median notch and extend along the leading edge and central interior of both lobes, with mottled transition zones.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch with an estimated pixel angle of 100 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel amplitudes ranging from 2-8 pixels along the entire trailing edge; notably jagged peaks are visible at the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge of both lobes, tapering to sharp points at the lateral extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small, high-contrast white circular pixel clusters (2-4 pixel diameter) are visible within the dark pigmented central region near the peduncle attachment.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct, parallel light-gray linear pixel disruptions oriented horizontally on the dark pigment of the inner left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent reddish-brown pixel clusters (potential bio-fouling or necrotic tissue) are localized at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right fluke lobes.
